expanded_body:
Originally posted May 1, 2026.

I write articles about poker. I also play poker. And sometimes… I bag Day 2.

Fired ONE bullet — a $130 buy-in — in Flight 1B of the Poker House Fort Worth $25,000 Guaranteed No-Limit Hold'em tournament and bagged 210,000 chips heading into Day 2 on Sunday (finishing second among the seven Flight 1B survivors when play paused at Level 16, blinds 5,000/10,000: Mark W 304,000, Sham 210,000, Jim 191,000, Ryno 148,000, Tommy W 144,000, Bryan T 92,000, and Janice R 28,000). One and done.

Now for the local weekend grinders: with Sunday's Day 2 already locked in, Saturday is wide open, and the DFW schedule options are outstanding:
• Texas Card House Dallas — $50,000 Guaranteed ($250 buy-in)
• Palace Poker — $50,000 Guaranteed ($250 buy-in)

Both run on Saturday. Pick one, win both days, and have a fat weekend.

That's the move, people:
• Friday night — Go bag Day 2 at Poker House Fort Worth.
• Saturday — Fire one of the $50K guarantees at TCH Dallas or Palace Poker.
• Sunday — Cash out on Day 2 at Poker House Fort Worth.

Chip up, stack up, win big. The DFW poker scene is alive right now and the schedule is set up perfectly.

P.S. You could also bag the WSOP Circuit Main Event at TCH Austin and then drive back up to DFW for a Saturday $50K — but that's only for real warriors.

— Sham
